notes.title: Dynasty Protocol Demo - Tips for the Best Experience
notes.notes: [p]Thank you for downloading and playing the Dynasty Protocol demo! Based on community feedback, here are some important tips to help you get the most out of your demo experience:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Game Speed Settings:[/b] The demo experience varies significantly based on your chosen game speed:[/p][list][*][p][b]Normal Speed:[/b] Combat begins later in the session, allowing more time for resource gathering and fleet building[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fastest Speed:[/b] Combat typically starts within 20-25 minutes, providing quicker access to battles and tactical gameplay[/p][/*][/list][p]I recommend trying the fastest speed setting if you want to experience combat sooner.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Demo Limitations:[/b] Please note that certain features are restricted in the demo version:[/p][list][*][p][b]Dark Matter production is disabled[/b] - This advanced resource system is exclusive to the full version[/p][/*][*][p][b]Limited ship types and technologies[/b] - The demo focuses on core mechanics and basic fleet combat[/p][/*][*][p][b]Simplified economy[/b] - Full resource management and trading systems are available in the complete game[/p][/*][/list][p][b]What the Demo Showcases:[/b] The demo is designed to highlight:[/p][list][*][p]Resource gathering and asteroid mining mechanics[/p][/*][*][p]Basic fleet management and logistics[/p][/*][*][p]Combat with select ship types[/p][/*][*][p]Core gameplay systems and UI design[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Full Version Benefits[/b] The complete Dynasty Protocol offers expanded content, including full technology trees, all ship types, Dark Matter systems, colony management, and much more.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for being part of our community and providing valuable feedback. Your support helps make Dynasty Protocol better![/p]

notes.title: Colony Governance Update: Shape Your Dynasty Through Policies & Taxation
notes.notes:
[img]https://shared.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3438130/53b4887b4c58b61a0e3450567f16c3f4156b55d7/ss_53b4887b4c58b61a0e3450567f16c3f4156b55d7.1920x1080.jpg?t=1742459092[/img]

[b]Greetings, Commanders![/b]

I'm excited to reveal a major feature coming to Dynasty Protocol: the Colony Management System!

🌟 UPCOMING FEATURE: COLONY GOVERNANCE
The Colony Management System will put you in complete control of how your colonies operate across the galaxy:


[b]Tax Collection System:[/b]
Determine taxation rates on different resources extracted from each colony. Will you demand high titanium taxes while keeping oxygen levies low? Every decision impacts colonial productivity and satisfaction.

[b]Policy Implementation:[/b]
Choose from various governance policies that shape how your colonies function. Each policy brings unique advantages:

[b]Military Presence:[/b] 
Increases defense capabilities

[b]Economic Focus: [/b]
Boosts resource production

[b]And more![/b]

[b]Colony Happiness: [/b]
Your taxation decisions directly affect colony happiness. Neglect this at your peril - unhappy colonies will declare independence faster when left undefended!

[b]Strategic Risk Management:[/b]
Find the perfect balance between extracting maximum resources and maintaining colony loyalty. Push too hard, and you might trigger rebellion; be too gentle, and your empire might lack the resources to compete.

This feature represents another step toward creating the deep, strategic space RTS experience I've been working toward. Your decisions as a commander will extend beyond the battlefield to the political and economic landscape of your empire.

Stay tuned for more updates as I approach the release of Dynasty Protocol. Your interest and support during this development journey has been invaluable.

Commander out.

notes.title: New Language Available: Brazilian Portuguese!
notes.notes:
[b]Stellar Commanders,[/b]

I am pleased to announce that the interface of DYNASTY PROTOCOL has been fully localized to Brazilian Portuguese!

From the launch version, the entire game interface, unit descriptions, technologies, menus, and tutorials will be available in Brazilian Portuguese. The game audio will remain in the original language.
This update is part of my commitment to make DYNASTY PROTOCOL accessible to players around the world.

I look forward to your feedback on the translation in our official forum after launch.

Until next time among the stars!

notes.title: Dynasty Protocol Demo - Command Your Space Empire
notes.notes:
[h1]Greetings, Space Commanders![/h1]

I'm excited to announce that the Dynasty Protocol demo is coming soon to Steam! As a solo developer, I've been working tirelessly to create an immersive space RTS that combines resource management, strategic warfare, and colony development.

[previewyoutube=CuV0eL8FHy4;full][/previewyoutube]

The demo will give you a comprehensive 60-minute glimpse into the Dynasty Protocol universe, featuring:

[list]
[*] Complete the tutorial series to master basic mechanics
[*] Fleet management and combat systems
[*] Resource extraction from asteroids
[*] Multiple game speed options
[*] One playable colony with unique traits and abilities
[*] Base building and module customization
[*] Strategic resource management (Oxygen, Hydrogen, Dark Matter)
[/list]
The demo will be available in English, Turkish, Russian, German, and French, ensuring that commanders worldwide can fully immerse themselves in the experience.

While the demo version will have some features locked and a time limit, it will provide more than enough time to experience the core gameplay mechanics that make Dynasty Protocol unique in the space RTS genre.

Stay tuned for the official demo release date announcement. Don't forget to wishlist Dynasty Protocol and join our growing community on Reddit, and X for the latest updates!


The stars await your command...
